resources.string: Allow code-only rollback for this update (off by default)
Limit: %1$s characters, %2$s nesting levels. S1 does not validate against the tool schema.
Arguments exceed %1$s characters; edit or shorten them.
Closing requests cancellation but does not release an occupied worker slot. The manager continues tracking actual exit. Uncooperative full-trust code may require a process restart.
WARNING: no data snapshot or data rollback, including preferences and secrets. Old code will receive the newer data and may be incompatible.
I reviewed this exact digest and every full destination; author identity is unverified.

Only a host-owned read-only content page is enabled. No provider engine, MCP connection/auth, Skill execution, persona application or language override. Updates replace the page snapshot, not an agent run. Existing disabled state is preserved.
Data recovery mode: importing is unavailable until a resumed cold start.
Uninstall retains data ID ownership; cross-type reuse is unavailable.
Untrusted plain text / JSON. No links, execution, authentication or network requests.
Data recovery mode: import and enabling are unavailable in this process. Resume only applies at the next cold start.
Declarations are metadata, not a permission sandbox or approval.
SHA-256 checks byte consistency, not author identity or update trust
Entry state describes the listener only. No agent/chat backend is connected; opening a session remains unavailable.
Entry lifetime attempt limit reached; additional listeners were not started. Restart required.
Actual execution exited; worker capacity has been released.
Actual execution has NOT exited. A terminal result, timeout or cancellation is not proof of exit; capacity may remain occupied.
Confirming requests framework scope and publishes this exact payload. First signer is pinned; a different signer is rejected.

If Theta cannot open: disable Theta or remove target scope in the framework manager, then force-stop target. Last resort: disable the framework in root manager or uninstall Theta with adb. Startup quarantine is target/version-local; clearing target data resets it.
S1 Modern Hook — dedicated ordinary target only
Full-trust code runs inside the target. Live disable depends on framework preference delivery; restart the target to exit Hook code. No custom target-to-Theta callback endpoint.
APK and data ZIP are separate routes. Failed APK verification never falls back to data.
%1$s\nFirst install enables the plugin. Updates preserve enabled state and take effect after restarting the app.
Integrity verified; author identity not authenticated.
Invalid JSON arguments. Check object syntax, size and nesting limits.
Restarting or reopening this screen does not reset it.
24-hour observation starts only after this version first starts successfully.
The 24-hour observation starts at the updated version\'s first successful start, not installation or reopening this dialog.
Operation failed. See diagnostic logs for technical details.
Cannot save plugin-page recovery journal; page execution blocked.
Request scope and publish reviewed APK
Recovery requested. To skip all plugins, launch recovery after force-stopping the app.
Could not save recovery request; plugins remain suppressed.
Delete this rejected package, all its data and its signer binding. This does not trust or run the package.
Result text display truncated to 4096 characters.
Resume saved for next cold start

CODE-ONLY rollback: after a cold restart the previous code returns, but current data, preferences and secrets remain unchanged. There is NO data rollback; the old code may be incompatible with newer data.
Normal rollback restores this plugin\'s private data directory, including preferences and secrets. Changes outside it are not restored.
Code-only rollback: NO data, preferences or secrets rollback.
Rollback includes plugin private data, preferences and secrets.
Rollback availability is decided by the manager, not a UI countdown.

Normal rollback: after a cold restart the previous code and its pre-update private data, preferences and secrets return. Changes saved in that directory since the snapshot are lost. Changes outside it are not restored.
Rollback details are unavailable; this confirmation cannot proceed.
Safe mode: code and data suppressed for this process.
Safe mode: code suppressed for this process.
This signer set is pinned until an explicit clear-data uninstall. Plugins execute with the host\'s full privileges.
Open target settings — force-stop, then relaunch
Direct full-trust plugin call, not an agent run. Approval requests are denied; input requests return unavailable. Cancellation does not undo effects.
Tool name and spec are read only by the admitted worker after invocation.
Tool registration is no longer available for a new call.
Revoke its host page and delete archives. ID ownership is retained, including after restart; code reuse and explicit release are not offered. No plugin private data was initialized.
Host extensions are removed immediately. Loaded code and files may remain until the app restarts.
Crash suspect; disabled until explicitly enabled
Safe mode; loading skipped until restart
Crash quarantine acknowledgement failed; loading blocked until restart
Disabled; restart required before loading again
Enabled for next start; restart required
Update failed; rollback on next start
Managed scope failed; disabled in process; persistence failed; restart required
Managed scope failed; disabled; cleanup failed; restart required
Managed scope failed; disabled; restart required
Safe mode; data activation skipped until restart
Crash quarantined; explicitly enable to validate and resume
Framework unavailable; open LSPosed and enable the module
Multiple framework services; restart with one framework
Framework disconnected; target restart required, switch propagation unknown
Global switch saved; live propagation unverified. Force-stop target for guaranteed code exit.
Published %1$s; cold-restart target. Target execution not yet verified.
Remote cleanup incomplete; next publication blocked until cleanup succeeds.
%1$d plugin diagnostic failures. See diagnostic logs for technical details.
Entry diagnostic details are available in diagnostic logs.
Invocation diagnostic details are available in diagnostic logs.
Import cleanup is pending. Use Retry import cleanup, then import again.
Package changed while installing (digest mismatch). Select the file again and review its digest before retrying.
Package signer does not match the trusted signer. Select an update signed by the original signer.
APK signature verification failed. Select an intact, correctly signed APK.
Signer binding is missing. Use clear-data uninstall before installing again; this deletes retained plugin data.
This version is already installed or older. Select a higher version to update.
An update or rollback is pending. Restart the app before retrying.
The plugin API level is unsupported. Select a plugin compatible with this host.
The import confirmation is no longer valid. Select the file again and confirm the new import.
The data page is no longer active. Return to the plugin list and check its state before reopening.
Cannot read the selected file. Select an accessible file using the system document picker.
The plugin or tool is no longer active. Return to the plugin list and enable it before retrying.
The tool is quarantined after repeated failures. Restart the app before retrying.
Tool execution capacity is unavailable. Wait for active calls to exit before retrying.
